title: TPMS Steady and TPMS Flashing Are Different Clues
topic: A steady TPMS warning and a startup flash-then-steady sequence can indicate different problems
mechanicTruth: A steady TPMS warning generally indicates significant underinflation, while a warning that flashes for roughly 60 to 90 seconds at startup and then stays on can indicate a TPMS system malfunction.
